name: Frontier Airlines World Mastercard® Credit Card

localized_names.en: Frontier Airlines World Mastercard® Credit Card

apr.notes: APR for purchases: 19.49% to 29.49% variable based on creditworthiness. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for first 15 billing cycles within 45 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 29.49%. APR for cash advances: 29.74% variable. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10).

fx_fee.notes: Disclosure states 'Foreign transaction fee: 0%.' Page also states 'No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.'

base_rate.description: Earn 1x miles on all other purchases.

categories.label: flyfrontier.com purchases (5x card earn; up to 15x total incl. 10x Frontier Miles member bonus)

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles never expire as long as card account is open and in good standing. No blackout dates on award travel. Award travel can be booked for one-way tickets once a minimum of 5,000 Travel Miles have been earned and round trip tickets once 10,000 Travel Miles earned.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 Travel Miles after spending $1,000 on purchases and paying the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Two Free Checked Bags
benefits.description: Two free checked bags on eligible Frontier flights.

benefits.title: $100 Flight Voucher Every Anniversary
benefits.description: Earn a $100 Flight Voucher every account anniversary after spending $2,500 or more on purchases with your card during your cardmembership year.

benefits.title: Instant Elite Gold Status
benefits.description: Unlock Instant Elite Gold Status after first purchase with your card, in the first 90 days after account opening. To maintain Elite Gold for 12 months, must spend $3,000 in Net Purchases in first 90 days.

benefits.title: Miles Never Expire
benefits.description: Miles never expire as long as your card account is open and in good standing.

benefits.title: No Blackout Dates
benefits.description: Redeem miles any day with no blackouts on award travel.

benefits.title: Award Redemption Fee Waiver
benefits.description: Award redemption fee waiver when you book an award ticket and use your Frontier Airlines World Mastercard to pay the related taxes and fees, starting from $5.60 for a one-way ticket.

benefits.title: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Priority boarding allows cardmembers to enjoy Group 4 boarding.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Complimentary FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Complimentary online access to your FICO Credit Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: Free Companion Travel at Elite Platinum Status
benefits.description: Unlock Free Companion Travel at Elite Platinum Status. Reach Elite Status faster by earning 1 Elite Status Point for every $1 spent on your card. Government fees apply.

benefits.title: Free Seat Upgrades with Elite Gold Status
benefits.description: Free seat upgrades with Elite Gold Status.
